newsitem.title: USA: Triple P loses distribution center.
newsitem.headline: Triple P loses distribution center.

text.p: Triple P NV said on Friday that it has reallocated nationwide distribution of its products in the Netherlands following the loss of one of its distribution centers in Vianen due to fire.
Triple P said that it expects that this event will not affect the operational results or financial condition of the company.
According to the company, its insurance carrrier has advised it that its policy covers the damage.
The company said that it believes that clients will not experience any substantial delays in the delivery of their orders and that operations will continue without any interruption.
